report_type: external author chemistry reconciliation; no approval verdict

evidence.source_assertion: Purified GalA acting on gallate produced an NMR pattern assigned to keto OMA; the reaction product showed olefinic and aliphatic signals at 6.63 and 3.95 ppm.
evidence.source_locator: Figure3 caption, upper panel; Results: Characterization of the GA ring-cleavage product, final paragraph

claims.scope: 1 min,20C,pH7.0;200uM gallate,2ug GalA; publisher HTML text read; figure not visually retrieved
claims.disposition: Supports immediate GalA keto product. Earlier mixtures and the2014 DesB schematic do not replace this direct assignment. Native charge/protons are database normalization, not NMR measurements.

evidence.source_assertion: Adding GalD-containing E. coli BL21(DE3)(pETGalDc) extract produced a6.73ppm signal without the7.38ppm signal attributed to Z-OMAenol; the authors assigned E-OMAenol.
evidence.source_locator: Figure3 caption, middle panel; Results: GalD catalyses a new biochemical step, NMR paragraph

claims.scope: Experimental extract; source optical/NMR interpretation; HTML text read
claims.disposition: 2016 interprets this prior assignment as(2E,4E)-CHM. Do not describe2016 as a fresh complete NMR geometry determination or equate nativeZ,Z CPD185.

evidence.source_assertion: Keto OMA converted spontaneously at low rate; KTGAL extract increased conversion, whereas galD-disrupted extract did not. Recombinant GalD extract confirmed keto-enol isomerization.
evidence.source_locator: Results: GalD catalyses a new biochemical step, first paragraph; Figure4A-B caption

claims.disposition: Preserve both enzyme catalysis and native spontaneous=true. No claim that a GalD enzyme is universally indispensable at every gallate concentration.

evidence.source_assertion: KTGAL extracts hydrated enol OMA but showed no detected hydratase activity with fresh keto OMA. GalB overproduction supplied activity; purified GalB product NMR was consistent with CHA.
evidence.source_locator: Results: GalB is the founding member of a new family of zinc-containing hydratases, opening and product-NMR paragraphs; Figure3 lower panel caption

claims.scope: Fresh substrate and assay conditions; recombinant GalB purified from E.coli(pETGalB)
claims.disposition: Material flow through spontaneous tautomerization remains possible; this is not a universal negative on every keto-derived reaction mixture.

evidence.source_assertion: GalB hydration kinetics were measured using OMAenol, with Km85uM and Vmax76umol/min/mg.
evidence.source_locator: Results: GalB is the founding member of a new family of zinc-containing hydratases, kinetic-constants sentence

claims.scope: Purified recombinant GalB; reported optimum near30C,pH7
claims.disposition: Native activity metadata labels these substrate constants as CHA; retain the source conflict and ground this claim to the primary enol assay.

evidence.source_assertion: E.coli BL21(DE3)(pETGalC) extracts showed Mg2+-containing CHA aldolase activity; KTGAL extracts had activity and the galC-disrupted strain lacked detectable activity.
evidence.source_locator: Results: The galC gene encodes a CHA aldolase, first paragraph; Experimental procedures: Enzymatic assays

claims.scope: Coupled lactate-dehydrogenase/NADH assay described in methods
claims.disposition: Supports GalC CHA-cleavage assignment with native product equations; does not establish purified GalC independent Mg-only specificity or direct simultaneous quantification of both products by this assay.

evidence.source_assertion: GalB and Comamonas E6 LigJ utilized the same GalD-derived CHM preparation. The paper identifies that substrate as(2E,4E)-CHM using the prior2011 NMR assignment.
evidence.source_locator: PMC4817193 #sec28 paragraph1; #sec31 paragraph3; Figure1A (#F1)

claims.scope: KT2440 GalB versus recombinant E6 LigJ/PmdE; not SYK6 LigJ
claims.disposition: Supports the E,E source-bound interpretation. Similarity, rescue and cross-enzyme activity do not prove all LigJ homologs share identical substrates.

evidence.source_assertion: GalB catalyzed CHM hydration and CHA dehydration. Co2+-reconstituted GalB produced a negatively rotating CHA product and consumed the negative enantiomer from racemic CHA.
evidence.source_locator: PMC4817193 #sec16 final paragraph; #sec25 afterTable3; Table4 (#T4); Figure5 (#F5)

claims.scope: In vitro Co2+-reconstituted enzyme for optical measurements;100mM HEPES,pH7.5
claims.disposition: Use generic CHA identity with explicit negative optical sign. Generic identity does not mean the experimental product was racemic.

evidence.source_assertion: Figure9 models S-CHA but explicitly leaves the absolute configuration of the measured negative CHA product unknown.
evidence.source_locator: PMC4817193 Figure9 caption (#F9); Figure5 (#F5)

claims.scope: Proposed binding/catalytic geometry versus measured optical rotation
claims.disposition: No exact S-CHA endpoint follows solely from this paper. The2018 SYK6 LigJ product assignment must not be transferred to KT2440 GalB.

evidence.source_assertion: The authors propose that the CHM enolate is the catalytic substrate, based on an enol pKa near7.3 and pH-dependent activity; Figure9 depicts the deprotonated enol oxygen.
evidence.source_locator: PMC4817193 #sec26; #sec31 paragraph afterFigure9; Figure9A (#F9)

claims.disposition: The drawn enolate is charge-4; formal CHEBI58142 enol is charge-3. Keep biochemical normalization separate, with no guessed enolate CURIE or automatic coefficient substitution.

evidence.source_assertion: Figure1A distinguishes GalD-derived(2E,4E)-CHM from the(2Z,4E)-CHM previously observed in a LigI structure; the discussion questions whether the latter is physiological.
evidence.source_locator: PMC4817193 Figure1A (#F1); #sec31 paragraph3

claims.scope: Historical alternative isomer context, not a new LigI experiment
claims.disposition: The LigI alternative2Z,4E is also not the native-prose1Z,3Z isomer. Preserve all three geometric descriptions rather than treating names as interchangeable.

evidence.source_assertion: Figure1A draws gallate ring cleavage to an unnamed open-chain enol product; the paper studies DesB substrate recognition and does not newly assign solution product geometry.
evidence.source_locator: PLOS Figure1A; Results: Binding of Gallate to the Active Site; Discussion

claims.scope: SYK6 DesB schematic and structural study
claims.disposition: Manual graph transcription gives neutral E,E enol; after explicitly deprotonating only3carboxyls it matchesCHEBI58142. This calculated drawing interpretation is not direct evidence against GalA immediate keto product.

evidence.source_assertion: Figure 1A summarizes gallate-to-OMA keto/enol, CHA and pyruvate plus oxaloacetate, assigning GalA, GalD, GalB and GalC to the steps.
evidence.source_locator: PMC9942251 Figure 1A; XML fig[label="Figure 1"]

claims.scope: 2023 pathway schematic; not fresh product-NMR experiment
claims.disposition: The diagram corroborates pathway context but cannot settle historical geometry or absolute CHA configuration. Parent handles complete 2023 reporter evidence.

evidence.source_assertion: The2018 study reports that SYK6 LigJ hydrates(3Z)-KCH to CHA and that the product-bound structure assigns S stereochemistry at C4.
evidence.source_locator: Publisher/EuropePMC abstract, opening and product-bound stereochemistry sentences; DOI10.1021/acs.biochem.8b00713

claims.scope: Abstract-only main-paper chemistry access in this reconciliation
claims.disposition: KCH is not E,E-CHM or native keto OMA. This source concerns SYK6 LigJ, not KT2440 GalB or E6 LigJ. No KCH/S-CHA node substitution or new whole-route assertion is proposed.

evidence.source_assertion: The2019 study reports Novosphingobium KA1 LigU isomerization of(4E)-OMA to(3Z)-KCH by an allylic1,3-proton transfer.
evidence.source_locator: Publisher/EuropePMC abstract, opening and final sentences; DOI10.1021/acs.biochem.9b00549

claims.scope: Abstract-only main-paper chemistry access;2019SI retained but not relied on for main mechanism
claims.disposition: Distinct KA1 enzyme and reaction cannot rename the experimentally described KT2440 GalD step. Detailed modern LigU/LigJ comparison remains limited by main-paper access.

evidence.source_assertion: The native pathway comment links keto OMA conversion to CPD-185, while the formal reaction chain uses CPD-12849.
evidence.source_locator: /ptools-xml/Pathway/comment; /ptools-xml/Pathway/reaction-layout; RXN-9983/right; RXN-2463/right

claims.disposition: CPD185 isZ,Z/CHEBI57732;CPD12849 isE,E/CHEBI58142. Independent complete structures and2D-CML geometry differ. Retain discrepancy and use formal chain supported by2011/2016, without silently editing the source.

evidence.source_assertion: CHEBI58142 has charge-3 and the issued InChIKey QWLUKZXOQAQUFQ-DXLKSGPOSA-K; its IUPAC name is(1E,3E)-4-hydroxybuta-1,3-diene-1,2,4-tricarboxylate.
evidence.source_locator: Current issuing JSON default_structure and chemical_data; current issuing page IUPAC Name

claims.disposition: Historical cis,cis display wording is not proof of Z,Z identity; full stereochemical layers and issuing IUPAC name establish E,E.

evidence.source_assertion: CHEBI58075 has charge-3, formulaC7H5O8 and no specified absolute stereochemistry in its issuing structure.
evidence.source_locator: Current issuing JSON chemical_data and default_structure

claims.disposition: Generic here preserves an unspecified center; it does not assert racemate or establish the absolute configuration of the negative GalB product.

evidence.source_assertion: Figure 1 labels the unsaturated keto product after LigU as CHA, then also labels the hydroxylated saturated product after LigJ as CHA. Its legend identifies the pathway scheme as modified from reference 51.
evidence.source_locator: Figure 1, right-hand LigU/LigJ branch; Figure 1 legend

claims.scope: Primary drawing viewed; caption read through author full-text web transcription
claims.disposition: The first drawing has KCH-like topology, not CHM/enol or saturated CHA. Preserve the apparent label error; this background scheme is not new GalD product evidence or a source to replace E,E-CHM with KCH.
